_doc: Symbol-change watch registry. When an index member changes ticker, the old symbol stops receiving bars (data goes stale / 404s) while the new symbol carries the continuation. Each record maps old->new so (a) sp-500.json / universe files can be remapped, and (b) a freshness check can flag any 'old' symbol still present in a universe. 'effective_date' = last complete bar observed under 'old' in our data store. 'data_symbol' = the symbol that carries the maintained continuous series in THIS data ecosystem (may differ from the live exchange ticker; e.g. Fiserv trades as FI on NYSE but our continuous series is keyed FISV).
